## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:车队代理读的三份入口规则里,两处补上了「该用哪个现成工具」的指名,一处上限收紧到实际大小。
- 属于车队入口文件收口那张总卡的第十片,替派发席和开发代理省去自己摸索在飞检查与祖先判定的步骤。
- 只是规则文字与一个上限数字,出错时代理会读到旧指引,随时可以直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- Item 4 — `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈车道与域〉: the in-flight line now names its reader, `node scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs --inflight` (usage verified in that script's header and usage text: `--inflight --paths=PATH[,PATH…] [--card=N] [--repo=OWNER/NAME]`). Paid for in the same file by prose tightening on seven other lines; no rule, gate name or command removed.
- Item 12 — `AGENTS.md`: the `git-history.mjs` paragraph now names the containment reading, `git-history.mjs ancestor` (usage verified: `ancestor --commit=SHA [--ref=origin/main] [--control=SHA]`). Paid for in the same file by trimming filler words in four nearby sentences ("actually", "simply", "really exists", "Better still, don't stage it at all").
- Item 13 — `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: the `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` CEILINGS row is LOWERED 33504 → 33500, the file's size at this head (headroom 0); row comment prepended in the file's own "lowered A → B by …; before that: …" style. No row is raised.
- Item 15 — verified, no edit: `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` line 194 points at `references/dev-traps.md`〈浅检出上的祖先读数〉, and that block's line 24 ends 「现读 `git-history.mjs ancestor`」, so a reader following the pointer reaches the subcommand. `os-dev.md` is untouched.

| File | before | after | net | ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 33345 | 33342 | -3 | 33351 (unchanged) |
| `AGENTS.md` | 78712 | 78709 | -3 | 78712 (unchanged) |
| `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` | 33500 | 33500 | 0 | 33504 → 33500 (lowered) |

Line counts of `AGENTS.md` and `SKILL.md` are unchanged. No volatile count is introduced.

## Tests

No tested behaviour changed (a ceiling lowered to the measured size, and prose), so no ablation. The ratchet's own self-test runs inside `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`.

## Acceptance notes

- Not touched, left on the card: items 7-option-B, 8, 9, 14, 20, 21.
- The ratchet prints tightening hints outside this slice's fence, left as they are: `SKILL.md` ceiling headroom 9 after this PR, the `AGENTS.md` table-row pin headroom 17 (pin 768, widest 751), and the `spec-property-retirement` pins.
- No changeset: every path is on the fast track (`.claude/**`, `scripts/pm/**`, root instruction file); none ships in any package's `files[]`. `skip-changeset` is applied with the create.

</details>
